svg.aria-label: Halftone Horizon — field, cell geometry and layer registration
svg.text: The host clips the canvas at its edges.
The cell grid stays square as the host resizes.
Positive curvature lifts the central bands.
The ready canvas fades in over the CSS gradient.
Before first paint or on context loss, the gradient is visible.
Dark edge at top · grayscale reference · caller-sized frame
Top direction · mirrored about the centerline
Band curvature follows the frame aspect ratio. Cell pitch is in CSS pixels.
At the cell center, sample the curved field level ℓ.
The edge feathers from r − A to r + A.
Three samples of one square cell · nominal ink boundary enlarged
At full growth the nominal radius exceeds the center-to-corner distance.
Adjacent cells read as a continuous field as the gaps close.
Equal field level · transverse section · dark edge above
